title: Key word transformations 2
summary_es: Seis frases: «in spite of», «would rather», verbos frasales, present perfect, necesidad y pasiva impersonal.

items.original: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
items.explanation_es: Although + oración = in spite of + nombre. Ojo: «in spite of», pero «despite» sin of.

items.original: I'd prefer you not to tell anyone about this.
items.explanation_es: Would rather + sujeto + pasado: para decir lo que preferimos que haga otra persona, el verbo va en pasado aunque se hable del presente.

items.original: Could you look after my cat while I'm away?
items.explanation_es: Look after = take care of (cuidar de).

items.original: The last time I saw Anna was at her wedding.
items.explanation_es: «The last time… was» = present perfect negativo + since + el momento.

items.original: It wasn't necessary for you to bring any food.
items.explanation_es: Falta de necesidad en el pasado: didn't need to + infinitivo.

items.original: People say that the castle is haunted.
items.explanation_es: Pasiva impersonal: sujeto + is said + to + infinitivo. Muy frecuente en noticias.
